s0301.literal: Eleventh month, guihai: Prince Yahu was enfeoffed as Prince of Chu, granted a gold seal, and a prince's tutor was appointed.
s0301.idiomatic: Eleventh month, guihai: Prince Yahu was enfeoffed as Prince of Chu, granted a gold seal, and a prince's tutor was appointed.

s0302.literal: A Buddhist temple was built on Wutai Shan.
s0302.idiomatic: A Buddhist temple was built on Wutai Shan.

s0303.literal: On yichou day central secretariat officials said: "For imperial guard grain rations and horse and camel fodder, those in offices hereditarily succeeded from father to son or among brothers should receive them; for those who should not receive them, we request that Lekesun cull them.
s0303.idiomatic: On yichou day central secretariat officials said, "For imperial guard grain rations and horse and camel fodder, those in offices hereditarily succeeded from father to son or among brothers should receive them; for those who should not receive them, we request that Lekesun cull them.

s0304.literal: At the reckoning at the end of the tenth month this year, horses and camels number more than ninety-three thousand; by the second month of next spring there will be a shortfall of six million bundles of fodder and one hundred fifty thousand shi of grain feed;
s0304.idiomatic: At the reckoning at the end of the tenth month this year, horses and camels number more than 93,000; by the second month of next spring there will be a shortfall of 6 million bundles of fodder and 150,000 shi of grain feed;

s0305.literal: moreover horses have again increased by more than fifty thousand head.
s0305.idiomatic: moreover horses have again increased by more than 50,000 head.

s0306.literal: This is a grave state matter; we your ministers venture to report it above."
s0306.idiomatic: This is a grave state matter; we your ministers venture to report it above."

s0307.literal: An order stated: "Those who should not receive it shall not receive it."
s0307.idiomatic: An order stated, "Those who should not receive it shall not receive it."

s0308.literal: On bingyin day the Emperor attended Longfu Palace, presenting the empress dowager's jade book and jade seal.
s0308.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Emperor attended Longfu Palace, presenting the empress dowager's jade book and jade seal.

s0309.literal: On dingmao day Venus transgressed Fang.
s0309.idiomatic: On dingmao day Venus transgressed Fang.

s0310.literal: Kuor Bar Yali said: "Reintroducing silver notes and copper cash would be convenient."
s0310.idiomatic: Kuor Bar Yali said, "Reintroducing silver notes and copper cash would be convenient."

s0311.literal: The central secretariat together with the privy council, censorate, Jixian Academy, and Hanlin academy senior ministers were ordered to assemble and deliberate, then report.
s0311.idiomatic: The central secretariat together with the privy council, censorate, Jixian Academy, and Hanlin academy senior ministers were ordered to assemble and deliberate, then report.

s0312.literal: On jisi day central secretariat officials Ashabuhua and Boluo Temür said: "We and Kuor Bar Yali discussed face to face the redemption of silver notes and copper cash — it is not convenient."
s0312.idiomatic: On jisi day central secretariat officials Ashabuhua and Boluo Temür said, "We and Kuor Bar Yali discussed face to face the redemption of silver notes and copper cash — it is not convenient."

s0313.literal: An order stated: "Since you consider it inconvenient, do not implement it."
s0313.idiomatic: An order stated, "Since you consider it inconvenient, do not implement it."

s0314.literal: An edict declared: "There are twelve posts in the central secretariat; Tuohuotuo still heads the Xuanzheng Bureau, Jiaohua remains in the capital — the rest each take up their duties."
s0314.idiomatic: An edict declared, "There are 12 posts in the central secretariat; Tuohuotuo still heads the Xuanzheng Bureau, Jiaohua remains in the capital — the rest each take up their duties."

s0315.literal: On gengwu day Lulong, Luanhe, Qian'an, Changli, and Funing counties suffered flooding; the people were famished; one thousand ingots of notes were granted for relief.
s0315.idiomatic: On gengwu day Lulong, Luanhe, Qian'an, Changli, and Funing counties suffered flooding; the people were famished; 1,000 ingots of notes were granted for relief.

s0316.literal: On xinwei day Talahai was put in charge of the Central Regency Directorate.
s0316.idiomatic: On xinwei day Talahai was put in charge of the Central Regency Directorate.

s0317.literal: On yihai day central secretariat officials said: "The Dadu Route supply burden is vast and complicated, and is generally drawn from subordinate prefectures.
s0317.idiomatic: On yihai day central secretariat officials said, "The Dadu Route supply burden is vast and complicated, and is generally drawn from subordinate prefectures.

s0318.literal: Military households, relay households, falconry offices, crane handlers, and the like, relying on exemption from miscellaneous corvée, fraudulently register themselves among the tax rolls.
s0318.idiomatic: Military households, relay households, falconry offices, crane handlers, and the like, relying on exemption from miscellaneous corvée, fraudulently register themselves among the tax rolls.

s0319.literal: We request an imperial edict be sent down; according to the ancestral old system, all are to share burdens equally.
s0319.idiomatic: We request an imperial edict be sent down; according to the ancestral old system, all are to share burdens equally.

s0320.literal: Those who presumptuously memorialize requests should also be forbidden."
s0320.idiomatic: Those who presumptuously memorialize requests should also be forbidden."

s0322.literal: The crown prince said: "Recently by grace I was granted Anxi, Jizhou, and Pingjiang as appanages, with all rents and taxes granted to me.
s0322.idiomatic: The crown prince said, "Recently by grace I was granted Anxi, Jizhou, and Pingjiang as appanages, with all rents and taxes granted to me.

s0323.literal: I fear imperial kin and brothers will cite precedent; apart from five-household silk tribute, the remainder I request be paid into the inner treasury.
s0323.idiomatic: I fear imperial kin and brothers will cite precedent; apart from five-household silk tribute, the remainder I request be paid into the inner treasury.

s0324.literal: The Shaanxi salt office annually handles one hundred thousand salt certificates, formerly given to the Prince of Anxi; we request this money be weighed and granted to me — may Your Majesty decide."
s0324.idiomatic: The Shaanxi salt office annually handles 100,000 salt certificates, formerly given to the Prince of Anxi; we request this money be weighed and granted to me — may Your Majesty decide."

s0325.literal: The central secretariat calculated the three routes' rents and salt proceeds at four hundred thousand ingots of notes.
s0325.idiomatic: The central secretariat calculated the three routes' rents and salt proceeds at 400,000 ingots of notes.

s0326.literal: An order stated: "The crown prince's thinking is very good; each year one hundred thousand ingots shall be granted; if insufficient, grant again."
s0326.idiomatic: An order stated, "The crown prince's thinking is very good; each year 100,000 ingots shall be granted; if insufficient, grant again."

s0327.literal: Music performers beat a person; the Ministry of Justice arrested them; the director of the Yuchen Music Bureau said the Yuchen Bureau and the Ministry of Justice were both rank 3, and their chiefs were both Grand Masters for Glorious Goodness — he detained and did not release them.
s0327.idiomatic: Music performers beat a person; the Ministry of Justice arrested them; the director of the Yuchen Music Bureau said the Yuchen Bureau and the Ministry of Justice were both rank 3, and their chiefs were both Grand Masters for Glorious Goodness — he detained and did not release them.

s0328.literal: The central secretariat reported this; the Emperor said: "For every office, according to their qualifications assign them nominal ranks — they may not exceed their grade.
s0328.idiomatic: The central secretariat reported this; the Emperor said, "For every office, according to their qualifications assign them nominal ranks — they may not exceed their grade.

s0329.literal: Those holding idle sinecures with high titles should, following the old system, be reduced."
s0329.idiomatic: Those holding idle sinecures with high titles should, following the old system, be reduced."

s0330.literal: Jiankang Route's subordinate prefectures and counties suffered famine; an edict remitted this year's wine and vinegar taxes.
s0330.idiomatic: Jiankang Route's subordinate prefectures and counties suffered famine; an edict remitted this year's wine and vinegar taxes.

s0331.literal: On bingzi day the moon transgressed Eastern Well.
s0331.idiomatic: On bingzi day the moon transgressed Eastern Well.

s0332.literal: On dingchou day central secretariat officials said: "Previously because of great flooding in Jiangnan, tea and salt levies were collected in rice to relieve the famished people.
s0332.idiomatic: On dingchou day central secretariat officials said, "Previously because of great flooding in Jiangnan, tea and salt levies were collected in rice to relieve the famished people.

s0333.literal: Now merchants deliver rice in exchange for salt, causing rice prices to surge; though the people gain a small profit, in the end it is of no benefit.
s0333.idiomatic: Now merchants deliver rice in exchange for salt, causing rice prices to surge; though the people gain a small profit, in the end it is of no benefit.

s0334.literal: We your ministers consider that tea and salt levies should revert to the old way."
s0334.idiomatic: We your ministers consider that tea and salt levies should revert to the old way."

s0336.literal: On wuyin day the crown prince was granted the jade book.
s0336.idiomatic: On wuyin day the crown prince was granted the jade book.

s0337.literal: On jimao day, upon completion of the crown prince's investiture ceremony, the Emperor took Great Brightness Hall and received the court audience of princes and all officials.
s0337.idiomatic: On jimao day, upon completion of the crown prince's investiture ceremony, the Emperor took Great Brightness Hall and received the court audience of princes and all officials.

s0338.literal: On gengchen day central secretariat officials said: "The crown prince told us: My appanages Anxi, Pingjiang, and Jizhou — following the old system, apart from the darughachi, all other regular appointments should follow regular selection; suitable talent should quickly be chosen for regular appointments."
s0338.idiomatic: On gengchen day central secretariat officials said, "The crown prince told us: My appanages Anxi, Pingjiang, and Jizhou — following the old system, apart from the darughachi, all other regular appointments should follow regular selection; suitable talent should quickly be chosen for regular appointments."

s0339.literal: An order stated: "Choose men and appoint them."
s0339.idiomatic: An order stated, "Choose men and appoint them."

s0340.literal: On yiyou day the moon transgressed Kang.
s0340.idiomatic: On yiyou day the moon transgressed Kang.

s0341.literal: An edict declared: "Rent, tax, and corvée of military and civilian households, artisans, and other households of the empress dowager — regular offices must not interfere; all are subordinate to the Huizheng Bureau."
s0341.idiomatic: An edict declared, "Rent, tax, and corvée of military and civilian households, artisans, and other households of the empress dowager — regular offices must not interfere; all are subordinate to the Huizheng Bureau."

s0342.literal: The Court of Imperial Studs was raised to rank 2b.
s0342.idiomatic: The Court of Imperial Studs was raised to rank 2b.

s0343.literal: On dinghai day Hangzhou, Pingjiang, and other places suffered great famine; five hundred one thousand two hundred shi of grain were distributed for relief.
s0343.idiomatic: On dinghai day Hangzhou, Pingjiang, and other places suffered great famine; 501,200 shi of grain were distributed for relief.

s0344.literal: On gengyin day Grand Preceptor Yuechiqier was granted forty qing of Jiangnan fields.
s0344.idiomatic: On gengyin day Grand Preceptor Yuechiqier was granted 40 qing of Jiangnan fields.

s0345.literal: At this time all granted fields were being resumed by the government; the central secretariat spoke on his behalf; an order stated: "Yuechiqier since Shizu's time has accumulated meritorious service; he is not comparable to others; all grants before and after, totaling one hundred qing, should be given him."
s0345.idiomatic: At this time all granted fields were being resumed by the government; the central secretariat spoke on his behalf; an order stated, "Yuechiqier since Shizu's time has accumulated meritorious service; he is not comparable to others; all grants before and after, totaling 100 qing, should be given him."

s0346.literal: Still an edict ordered branch secretariat pingzhang Biebiehua to receive its annual income.
s0346.idiomatic: Still an edict ordered branch secretariat pingzhang Biebiehua to receive its annual income.

s0347.literal: On xinmao day Mercury transgressed Jupiter.
s0347.idiomatic: On xinmao day Mercury transgressed Jupiter.

s0348.literal: At the crown prince's request, the censorate was to inspect the crown prince's household bureau documents.
s0348.idiomatic: At the crown prince's request, the censorate was to inspect the crown prince's household bureau documents.

s0349.literal: Twelfth month, renchen new moon: central secretariat officials said: "Under the old system, gold tiger tallies and gold and silver tallies were kept by the Imperial Insignia Bureau; when issued it was through the central secretariat, and when the matter ended they returned to the Imperial Insignia Bureau.
s0349.idiomatic: Twelfth month, renchen new moon: central secretariat officials said, "Under the old system, gold tiger tallies and gold and silver tallies were kept by the Imperial Insignia Bureau; when issued it was through the central secretariat, and when the matter ended they returned to the Imperial Insignia Bureau.

s0350.literal: Now issuance frequently bypasses the central secretariat; even down to merchants who cultivate connections with close attendants and memorialize — causing overflow, issued but never returned.
s0350.idiomatic: Now issuance frequently bypasses the central secretariat; even down to merchants who cultivate connections with close attendants and memorialize — causing overflow, issued but never returned.

s0351.literal: We your ministers request verification; from now on, apart from appointments and envoys who should receive them, none not through the central secretariat shall receive them."
s0351.idiomatic: We your ministers request verification; from now on, apart from appointments and envoys who should receive them, none not through the central secretariat shall receive them."

s0353.literal: They further said: "Now state expenditures are very great and treasury stores are already depleted; use reaching the note reserve is not proper.
s0353.idiomatic: They further said, "Now state expenditures are very great and treasury stores are already depleted; use reaching the note reserve is not proper.

s0354.literal: Salt certificates were formerly traded between the transport office and the people; now adapting measures to the times, selling eight hundred thousand salt certificates through the Ministry of Revenue would be convenient."
s0354.idiomatic: Salt certificates were formerly traded between the transport office and the people; now adapting measures to the times, selling 800,000 salt certificates through the Ministry of Revenue would be convenient."

s0355.literal: An order stated: "This year for now follow your request; do not repeat it afterward."
s0355.idiomatic: An order stated, "This year for now follow your request; do not repeat it afterward."

s0356.literal: They further said: "The Imperial Treasury serves as the inner storehouse; in Shizu and Chengzong's reigns, when heavy gifts were needed they were drawn from the central secretariat; now grants exceeding one thousand up to ten thousand ingots all come from the Imperial Treasury.
s0356.idiomatic: They further said, "The Imperial Treasury serves as the inner storehouse; in Shizu and Chengzong's reigns, when heavy gifts were needed they were drawn from the central secretariat; now grants exceeding 1,000 up to 10,000 ingots all come from the Imperial Treasury.

s0357.literal: Recently the Imperial Treasury drew fifty thousand ingots, two thousand already disbursed, and now again reports depletion.
s0357.idiomatic: Recently the Imperial Treasury drew 50,000 ingots, 2,000 already disbursed, and now again reports depletion.

s0358.literal: We request that from now on when the inner palace needs large amounts, they still be drawn from the central secretariat."
s0358.idiomatic: We request that from now on when the inner palace needs large amounts, they still be drawn from the central secretariat."

s0359.literal: The Emperor said: "This is my special order; afterward follow your memorial."
s0359.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "This is my special order; afterward follow your memorial."

s0360.literal: On yiwei day guichi Tatatu and others harassed Tanzhou commoners, forcibly taking more than six hundred shi of grain; officials were dispatched to try them.
s0360.idiomatic: On yiwei day guichi Tatatu and others harassed Tanzhou commoners, forcibly taking more than 600 shi of grain; officials were dispatched to try them.

s0361.literal: On xinchou day the Emperor visited the Great Sage Longevity Wan'an Monastery.
s0361.idiomatic: On xinchou day the Emperor visited the Great Sage Longevity Wan'an Monastery.

s0362.literal: Chanai, minister of personnel, was made grand councillor and placed in charge of the Ministry of Works.
s0362.idiomatic: Chanai, minister of personnel, was made grand councillor and placed in charge of the Ministry of Works.

s0363.literal: On guimao day ten thousand Han troops were garrisoned to farm at Karakorum; the garrison office was ordered to erect lamp mountains behind Great Brightness Hall and before Extended Spring Pavilion starting the fifteenth day of the first month next year.
s0363.idiomatic: On guimao day 10,000 Han troops were garrisoned to farm at Karakorum; the garrison office was ordered to erect lamp mountains behind Great Brightness Hall and before Extended Spring Pavilion starting the 15th day of the first month next year.

s0364.literal: On gengxu day the Branch Quanfu Office was raised to Quanfu Bureau, rank 2a.
s0364.idiomatic: On gengxu day the branch Quanfu Office was raised to Quanfu Bureau, rank 2a.

s0365.literal: Because Mongol commander of ten thousand households Temüder had merit in pacifying the internal crisis, he was promoted to general who stabilizes the state.
s0365.idiomatic: Because Mongol commander of ten thousand households Temüder had merit in pacifying the internal crisis, he was promoted to general who stabilizes the state.

s0366.literal: The crown prince's pharmaceutical office was raised to pharmaceutical directorate, rank 3a.
s0366.idiomatic: The crown prince's pharmaceutical office was raised to pharmaceutical directorate, rank 3a.

s0367.literal: Shandong, Henan, and Jiang-Zhe suffered famine; commoners were forbidden to brew wine.
s0367.idiomatic: Shandong, Henan, and Jiang-Zhe suffered famine; commoners were forbidden to brew wine.

s0368.literal: On dingsi day, because the central secretariat reported state expenditures vast and the people impoverished with failed harvests, an edict ordered the Xuanzheng Bureau to economize on Buddhist affairs.
s0368.idiomatic: On dingsi day, because the central secretariat reported state expenditures vast and the people impoverished with failed harvests, an edict ordered the Xuanzheng Bureau to economize on Buddhist affairs.

s0369.literal: The two relay routes of Dadu and Shangdu each had two imperially authorized officials appointed; other relay stations one each.
s0369.idiomatic: The two relay routes of Dadu and Shangdu each had two imperially authorized officials appointed; other relay stations one each.

s0370.literal: An edict directed princes, princesses, imperial sons-in-law, and envoys given sealed edicts and relay vouchers — they may not presumptuously use round tallies to use relay stations.
s0370.idiomatic: An edict directed princes, princesses, imperial sons-in-law, and envoys given sealed edicts and relay vouchers — they may not presumptuously use round tallies to use relay stations.

s0371.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Relay households are exhausted; relay service should be granted according to circumstances.
s0371.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "Relay households are exhausted; relay service should be granted according to circumstances.

s0372.literal: Now expenditures are vast; the purchase and sale of precious goods should for the moment be suspended.
s0372.idiomatic: Now expenditures are vast; the purchase and sale of precious goods should for the moment be suspended.

s0373.literal: Also, upon Your Majesty's accession the edict forbade overstepping one's office in memorializing; recently close attendants memorialize on appointments and requests for rewards — all descend as orders from within; we request that from now on what does not pass through the central secretariat shall not be implemented.
s0373.idiomatic: Also, upon Your Majesty's accession the edict forbade overstepping one's office in memorializing; recently close attendants memorialize on appointments and requests for rewards — all descend as orders from within; we request that from now on what does not pass through the central secretariat shall not be implemented.

s0374.literal: Also, criminal law is like a balance — it may not be weighted too heavily; Shizu already had fixed regulations; since Yuanzhen, because of Buddhist affairs, the guilty have been released — excessively lenient, so that offices have nothing to follow.
s0374.idiomatic: Also, criminal law is like a balance — it may not be weighted too heavily; Shizu already had fixed regulations; since Yuanzhen, because of Buddhist affairs, the guilty have been released — excessively lenient, so that offices have nothing to follow.

s0375.literal: Now we request that all who violate the law within and without, all be returned to the competent offices for judgment according to law.
s0375.idiomatic: Now we request that all who violate the law within and without, all be returned to the competent offices for judgment according to law.

s0376.literal: Also, where the people suffer famine in various places, apart from palace construction, labor corvée should all be suspended."
s0376.idiomatic: Also, where the people suffer famine in various places, apart from palace construction, labor corvée should all be suspended."

s0378.literal: They further said: "Statutes are urgent affairs in governing the state and should be revised in timely fashion.
s0378.idiomatic: They further said, "Statutes are urgent affairs in governing the state and should be revised in timely fashion.

s0379.literal: Shizu once had an order that the Jin Dynasty's Taihe Code should not be used; he ordered senior ministers versed in law to consult past and present and newly fix regulations — to this day they have not been implemented.
s0379.idiomatic: Shizu once had an order that the Jin Dynasty's Taihe Code should not be used; he ordered senior ministers versed in law to consult past and present and newly fix regulations — to this day they have not been implemented.

s0380.literal: We your ministers consider statutes a weighty matter and not lightly to be debated; we request that from Shizu's accession onward the regulations enacted be collated, unified, and followed."
s0380.idiomatic: We your ministers consider statutes a weighty matter and not lightly to be debated; we request that from Shizu's accession onward the regulations enacted be collated, unified, and followed."

s0382.literal: On gengshen day an edict declared:
s0382.idiomatic: On gengshen day an edict declared:

s0383.literal: Looking up, we consider that our ancestors answered Heaven and settled the realm, first opening the domain; China was united and none failed to follow.
s0383.idiomatic: Looking up, we consider that our ancestors answered Heaven and settled the realm, first opening the domain; China was united and none failed to follow.

s0384.literal: When We inherited the great enterprise and continued to receive the glorious mandate, We respectfully upheld the instructions left to Us and reverently emulated the grand pattern, reverently carrying awe and diligence, not knowing how to succeed.
s0384.idiomatic: When We inherited the great enterprise and continued to receive the glorious mandate, We respectfully upheld the instructions left to Us and reverently emulated the grand pattern, reverently carrying awe and diligence, not knowing how to succeed.

s0385.literal: Ever mindful of the hardship at the founding of the enterprise, We are alone in anxious concern;
s0385.idiomatic: Ever mindful of the hardship at the founding of the enterprise, We are alone in anxious concern;

s0386.literal: yet maintaining the entirety of ten thousand affairs falls upon Us alone.
s0386.idiomatic: yet maintaining the entirety of ten thousand affairs falls upon Us alone.

s0387.literal: Therefore from Our accession We have broadly followed leniency, assigning office according to capacity, enabling diligent fulfillment of duty, day and night making the enduring peace of the myriad people an urgent task.
s0387.idiomatic: Therefore from Our accession We have broadly followed leniency, assigning office according to capacity, enabling diligent fulfillment of duty, day and night making the enduring peace of the myriad people an urgent task.

s0388.literal: Recently years have repeatedly failed to yield harvests; displaced people have not returned; officials altogether encroach and exploit; above and below have been lax; the climate of harmony has turned adverse.
s0388.idiomatic: Recently years have repeatedly failed to yield harvests; displaced people have not returned; officials altogether encroach and exploit; above and below have been lax; the climate of harmony has turned adverse.

s0389.literal: Therefore we charge our arm-and-thigh ministers and ear-and-eye advisers — to think how to exhaust themselves in loyal support and good counsel, morning and evening entering to report; We command and it is assented to; affairs may all be harmonized; We joyfully share with the people throughout the realm the transformation of peace and good order; the near at peace, the far respectful — is this not good?
s0389.idiomatic: Therefore we charge our chief ministers — to think how to exhaust themselves in loyal support and good counsel, morning and evening entering to report; We command and it is assented to; that affairs may all be harmonized; We joyfully share with the people throughout the realm the blessings of peace and good order; the near at peace, the far respectful — would this not be excellent?

s0390.literal: Dade year 12 may be changed to Zhida year 1.
s0390.idiomatic: Dade year 12 may be changed to Zhida year 1.

s0391.literal: We proclaim this renewing order, thereby securing eternal blessing.
s0391.idiomatic: We proclaim this renewing order, thereby securing eternal blessing.

s0392.literal: Provide relief to Mongol and Han troops on campaign and garrison; rescue and repair depleted relay households.
s0392.idiomatic: Provide relief to Mongol and Han troops on campaign and garrison; rescue and repair depleted relay households.

s0393.literal: Lift prohibitions on mountain fields, river and lake fisheries, and reed marshes.
s0393.idiomatic: Lift prohibitions on mountain fields, river and lake fisheries, and reed marshes.

s0394.literal: Hunting and hawking may not disturb the common people; induce and attract displaced households to return.
s0394.idiomatic: Hunting and hawking may not disturb the common people; induce and attract displaced households to return.

s0395.literal: Forbid enrolling in keshig guard, falconry, and other categories to avoid corvée, or frivolously requesting grain and funds.
s0395.idiomatic: Forbid enrolling in keshig guard, falconry, and other categories to avoid corvée, or frivolously requesting grain and funds.

s0396.literal: Encourage agriculture and sericulture, establish schools, deliberate on the examination and tribute system, reward filial piety, brotherhood, and industrious farming, and punish idleness and wandering.
s0396.idiomatic: Encourage agriculture and sericulture, establish schools, deliberate on the examination and tribute system, reward filial piety, brotherhood, and industrious farming, and punish idleness and wandering.

s0397.literal: Whether government orders succeed or fail, all persons may submit memorials stating their views.
s0397.idiomatic: Whether government orders succeed or fail, all persons may submit memorials stating their views.

s0398.literal: Monks, Daoists, Nestorian Christians, and Dasman — all are to pay taxes according to the old system.
s0398.idiomatic: Monks, Daoists, Nestorian Christians, and Dasman — all are to pay taxes according to the old system.

s0399.literal: For all selection procedures, grain and funds, criminal cases, and construction — every official matter — close attendants may not overstep and report directly.
s0399.idiomatic: For all selection procedures, grain and funds, criminal cases, and construction — every official matter — close attendants may not overstep and report directly.

s0400.literal: It was directed that for Buddhist affairs within the inner palace, heavy criminals must not be released — release light criminals instead.
s0400.idiomatic: It was directed that for Buddhist affairs within the inner palace, heavy criminals must not be released — release light criminals instead.
